verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs describe a well-documented REST/SDK API (Python, JS/TS, Go, Java) covering generation, function calling, structured output, embeddings, live API, batch API, caching, safety settings, rate limits, pricing, and a changelog/deprecation policy, giving AI-native developers a full programmatic surface. Missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec (probes returned 404s) and community reports note onboarding/billing friction that could hinder frictionless agentic adoption.
